text: Can I be called a regular customer? 555... Every time I get sick, I see Khem here. The doctor is very kind... The staffs provide the best service. If you ask anything, they will answer everything. They never get irritated and never use a tone that shows they are irritated. I have been using their services since it was a drugstore... until the drugstore moved across the street and opened as a clinic. I have been using their services for many, many, many years. They still maintain the highest standards of service... it's good... it's the best. If I'm not feeling well... and the clinic is closed... I don't dare go to any other clinics because I'm afraid they won't be as good as here... I'm afraid of feeling bad... I will only go to the hospital. All the doctors are lovely... If you consult with them, they will give you answers like I'm family... They make patients dare to talk and consult... oh, love 💕💕
